entity_name: Народна банка на Република Северна Македонија
source_name: НБРСМ — Шема на платни системи и системи за порамнување на хартии од вредност
why_relevant: Authoritative map of every designated payment and securities settlement system in the country — the definitive actor list for this cell (MIPS, KIBS, CaSys, CSD) and the entry point to each operator.

entity_name: Народна банка на Република Северна Македонија
source_name: NBRM – Other institutions responsible for regulation and supervision of financial institutions
why_relevant: Regulator-curated actor map: the central bank's own list of the other MK financial supervisors (ISA/ASO, SEC, MAPAS, Deposit Insurance Fund, MoF). Best single seed for snowballing the full supervisory perimeter without guessing acronyms.

source_name: Uslugi.gov.mk — national institution/services register
why_relevant: Authoritative directory of state institutions and the services they run (including NBRSM and UJP entries). Useful for building and normalising the contracting-authority actor map that the ESJN and TED collectors filter on, and for spotting new/renamed bodies.

source_name: Портал на Министерството за дигитална трансформација / mdt.gov.mk — compilations of financial-system laws
why_relevant: Surfaced hosting a compiled document titled 'закони кои го регулираат финансискиот систем', i.e. a cross-institution list of the statutes in this cell's scope. Marginal but occasionally holds compilations not published elsewhere; a snowball target rather than a monitoring target.

source_name: uslugi.gov.mk — National Bank institutional service catalogue
why_relevant: State service catalogue listing NBRM's administrative procedures (licences, consents, registrations) with their legal bases. Useful as a pointer that maps which bylaw governs which supervised-entity obligation, and it surfaces procedure changes that follow a new decision — a cheap, unblocked proxy for the bot-defended nbrm.mk.

source_name: Министерство за финансии — Регистри (Ministry of Finance registers section)
why_relevant: MoF keeps registers for the non-NBRNM-supervised financial perimeter (notably финансиски друштва / financial companies and leasing), which are payments-adjacent obliged entities not covered by NBRNM registers.

source_name: Регистар на организации на потрошувачи (NGO cooperation portal listing of consumer organisations)
why_relevant: Enumerates the regional consumer organisations (Bitola, Tetovo, Ohrid, Štip, etc.) beyond ОПМ — expands the actor map for grievance channels that surface locally before they reach the regulator.

source_name: MASIT legacy publications archive (oldmasit)
why_relevant: Legacy archive of MASIT publications/position documents; older policy papers frequently disappear from the current site, so this is the archival tail for ICT-sector positions.

source_name: MASIT — Chamber of ICT Companies of North Macedonia, member directory
why_relevant: Authoritative local directory of ICT vendors; already surfaced CaSys and KIBS profiles. Best single snowball device for enumerating the MK supplier ecosystem (core banking, processing, integration, security) whose sites then reveal bank customers.

source_name: Стопанска комора на Северна Македонија — Здружение на финансиски организации
why_relevant: Fetched and confirmed: the Economic Chamber's Association of Financial Organisations claims to unite all 12 commercial banks, both savings houses, pension companies, insurers, leasing and non-bank lending companies. It is the venue where cross-sector industry comments on draft financial laws are consolidated before submission to the Ministry of Finance/NBRSM.

source_name: Стопанска комора — Групација на небанкарски финансиски друштва
why_relevant: Grouping of non-bank financial companies (formed 9 Oct 2019, ~22 of 26 entities). Explicit stated priority is a fintech-industry development strategy with supervisors and legislators — i.e. lobbying on draft rules covering non-bank credit and fintech.

source_name: Стопанска комора — Здружение на трговијата (Trade Association)
why_relevant: Represents wholesale/retail traders — the merchant side of payments. Relevant to fiscalisation rules, cash-registration law, card-acceptance/interchange and consumer-protection drafts; merchants are the counter-lobby to banks on payment cost rules.

source_name: Македонска банкарска асоцијација (MBA) — members and sector notices
why_relevant: Industry association whose membership (all banks, savings houses, KIBS clearing house, Macedonian Credit Bureau) mirrors the supervised population and which publishes sector notices about licensing/continuity of exchange offices and fast-transfer providers.

source_name: MBA — Членови (member directory of banks, savings houses, financial institutions)
why_relevant: Fetched and confirmed: enumerates the full ecosystem — 13 banks (Komercijalna, Stopanska, NLB, Halk, ProCredit, Sparkasse, UNIBanka, Razvojna, Alta, CKB, TTK, Kapital, Silk Road), 2 savings houses (Можности, ФУЛМ) and financial infrastructure members Клириншка куќа (KIBS) and Македонско кредитно биро. A ready-made actor map for downstream cells.

source_name: IMF Financial Sector Assessment Program (FSAP / FSSA) publication index
why_relevant: Central index for FSAP/FSSA outputs including Basel Core Principles compliance assessments and technical notes; the canonical place to detect whether/when a new MK FSAP is scheduled or published.

entity_name: MK business press cluster for event/award/hiring signals
source_name: MK business press cluster for event/award/hiring signals (Faktor, Makfax, Biznisvesti, Pari, eMagazin, MIA, MKD)
why_relevant: These outlets carry the announcements that first reveal conferences, licences, training academies and awards (EACHA conference hosting, KIBS instant-payments licence, MicroBalkans, Global Finance awards, ABIT enrolment). They are the discovery layer that points to the primary organiser sites which are then crawled directly.

source_name: University career/announcement boards republishing NBRSM vacancies (UKIM Economics Faculty, UACS, UIST)
why_relevant: MK faculties republish the full text of NBRSM and bank vacancy notices, often persisting after the original notice is taken down from nbrm.mk. Useful as a mirror/archive layer for dating supervisory hiring waves.

source_name: biznisregulativa.mk — chamber/association registry entry (MASIT and others)
why_relevant: A government-side business-regulation portal that lists recognised chambers ('Komoris') — useful as an authoritative index for enumerating which chambers/associations formally exist and are consulted, rather than relying on search discovery.

source_name: eCommerce4all.mk — e-payment processing landscape (MK acquiring/processing map)
why_relevant: Donor/programme-built guide enumerating MK acquiring banks and processors and how online transaction processing is organised; a compact actor map that lets you attribute later vendor announcements to the right bank/processor pair.

source_name: LEGISLATIONLINE (OSCE/ODIHR) — North Macedonia country page
why_relevant: OSCE/ODIHR repository of national legislation in English translation, including the Constitution and criminal/AML-adjacent statutes. Where an English rendering of a MK statute exists, this is a defensible, attributable one — helpful for briefing non-MK-reading stakeholders. Coverage of financial-sector statutes is likely partial and translations are unofficial.

source_name: Library of Congress — Guide to Law Online: North Macedonia (Legislative)
why_relevant: Curated, maintained English-language index of the official legislative sources for RNM (gazette, Assembly, legal databases). Valuable as a snowball seed and as a stable cross-check when official portals rename sections; not a content source itself.

source_name: skopjehacklab/e-nabavki — open-source machine-friendly scraper/dataset for e-nabavki.gov.mk
why_relevant: Civic-tech project that documents ESJN's undocumented endpoints and dossier URL patterns and produces machine-readable extracts. It is the fastest way to learn the portal's internal API surface (bypassing the 403/ASP.NET friction) and to validate a collection design.

source_name: Western Balkans Info Hub — enlargement document mirror
why_relevant: Independent mirror of EU enlargement documents (hosts the 2025 North Macedonia report PDF) — an archival fallback when Commission URLs rotate.

entity_name: Агенција за заштита на правото на слободен пристап до информации од јавен карактер
source_name: Агенција за заштита на правото на слободен пристап до информации од јавен карактер (ASPI) / slobodenpristap.mk — FOI route to procurement bodies
why_relevant: Maintains the register of information holders (иматели на информации) with FOI officers per institution, and slobodenpristap.mk hosts public FOI requests/answers. This is the legal fallback for obtaining tender documentation, contract annexes or specifications that are not published — and the register itself is a complete actor map of contracting authorities.

entity_name: Сојуз на стопански комори на Македонија
source_name: Сојуз на стопански комори на Македонија (Union of Chambers of Commerce)
why_relevant: Umbrella of ~35 chambers and 30+ associations, including the Chamber of Accountants, Financiers and Tax Advisors. Aggregates business-side reactions to fiscal and financial draft laws and reveals additional sub-chambers relevant to payments. Homepage URL inferred from its Facebook handle (www.chamber.mk) — unverified.

source_name: Фонд за осигурување на депозити (Deposit Insurance Fund) — member institutions
why_relevant: All licensed banks, foreign bank branches and savings houses are compulsory members; the Fund's membership list is an independent cross-check on the NBRNM licence register and reacts fast to failures/exits.
